title: Songweaver: song gauge, books and a growing lute
changes: The Songweaver's mana bubble is now a song gauge. Notes fill it, chords fill it faster, and when it is full your book's gift rings out. Wear a Songbook, Hymnal, War March or Dissonance book to choose the gift.
Attacks are now Verses and songs are Choruses. Rings under your feet show your Chorus and your chord as you play it, and nearby players can see them.
Find new songs in the world: from quests, from villagers and from the Mirror Pond. Each one adds a chord of its own.
Your lute now grows with you. Wren the lute-maker in Oakvale fits strings, bodies and tunings, and breaks old weapons and shields into materials.
